title: CLARA 2027 shared oracle decision record, version 1
description: One adjudication by an independent oracle (which never imports candidate code). OUTCOME is an explicit multi-valued enum including INDETERMINATE and NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL: an incomplete, stale or externally-blocked execution is recorded as such and is never counted as a safe rejection or a completion. Ground truth derives from frozen oracle labels and observed persisted state, not candidate reason codes.

oracle_id.description: Stable identifier of the independent oracle implementation (with its own version pin elsewhere); must be disjoint from candidate code.

independent_unit_id.description: Required. The independent unit this decision applies to; never inferred from timestamps.

case_id.description: Case within the unit family that was adjudicated.

outcome.description: Explicit outcome. INDETERMINATE = reconcilable ground truth absent/ambiguous. NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL = blocked by unavailable external dependency (provider, PG, reviewer). FORBIDDEN_EVENT = oracle-identified safety violation. Neither INDETERMINATE nor NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL may be tallied as rejection or success.

reason_code.description: Stable, machine-checkable reason code (never free prose, never candidate-supplied reason codes used as truth).

candidate_reason_code_ignored.description: True when the candidate's own claimed reason code was present but deliberately not used as ground truth (oracle independence).

evidence.description: At least one frozen evidence pointer supporting the decision (persisted DB state, history export, sealed log).

source_sha.description: Candidate source SHA the decision applies to (frozen).

adjudicated_at.description: Forensic timestamp only; carries no inferential weight and cannot substitute for independent_unit_id.

outcome.description: Reusable outcome enum; INDETERMINATE and NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL are mandatory first-class outcomes.
